title: Price-snapshot store — opening and closing numbers for every market we originate

contract.origination_order: side first, then total, then moneyline (S3)
contract.our_line: our own originated number — computed by the repo model, always recorded
contract.market_line: the market's number at that stage — recorded only from an official source; blank and flagged today because no league or club source publishes prices (Q-02)
contract.difference: fair line minus market line — must stay blank while market_line is blank; never derived from a third-party number
contract.capture_rule: a stage not captured in time keeps its status and an empty value; it is never back-filled from the other stage

source.label: NFL.com Week 10 schedule (the games these markets are originated on)

note: This store is append-ready: tools/build_snapshots.py regenerates it from the origination file and the capture log. When an official price source is settled (Q-02), market_line and difference fill from recorded captures only.
